mapper.select: SELECT delivery_nm, delivery_addr, delivery_daddr, delivery_zip_no, primary_location FROM delivery_list WHERE cust_id = #{custId} ORDER BY primary_location DESC

/* 검색 포함 전체 행 수 */ SELECT COUNT(di.del_info_no) FROM delivery_information di
di.recipient_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
di.cust_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
di.delivery_progress LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')

/* 회원 검색 배송지 정보 조회 */ SELECT dl.delivery_location_no, dl.cust_id, c.cust_nm, dl.delivery_nm, dl.primary_location, dl.delivery_addr, dl.delivery_daddr, dl.delivery_zip_no, dl.recipient_phone, dl.delivery_request, dl.register_date, dl.revision_date FROM delivery_list dl inner join customer c using(cust_id)
${searchKey} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%');

/* 배송지 정보 조회 */ SELECT dl.delivery_location_no, dl.cust_id, c.cust_nm, dl.delivery_nm, dl.primary_location, dl.delivery_addr, dl.delivery_daddr, dl.delivery_zip_no, dl.recipient_phone, dl.delivery_request, dl.register_date, dl.revision_date FROM delivery_list dl inner join customer c using(cust_id) WHERE dl.primary_location ='기본배송지' GROUP BY c.cust_id ORDER BY c.cust_nm;
